verdict.rationale: Better Stack's incident-management page says it can post a todo list when an incident is triggered, which is a first-party, if thinly documented, checklist capability. Nothing in the pack shows defined incident roles such as commander or comms lead; on-call schedules, escalation policies and routing to a responder are adjacent alerting features, not role assignment. Missing for 10: defined incident roles (commander, comms lead), detailed docs on checklist templates and task tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, incidents carry defined roles (commander, comms lead) and task checklists so response stays coordinated under pressure

citations.quote: Post a todo list when a new incident is triggered.
